columns.description: EIN of the organisation that FILED the return, nine digits zero-padded.
columns.name: filer_ein

columns.description: Filer name from its own return with BusinessNameLine1Txt and BusinessNameLine2Txt joined, because IRS e-file splits a name at 35 characters.
examples: MARICOPA COUNTY COMMUNITY COLLEGE DISTRICT FOUNDATION
Maricopa County Community College District Foundation
UNITED WAY OF THE GREATER CHIPPEWA VALLEY ENDOWMENT CORPORATION
UNITED WAY OF CAYUGA COUNTY INC
WESTERN DAKOTA VOCATIONAL TECHNICAL FOUNDATION INC
columns.name: filer_name_as_filed

columns.description: Which population the FILER belongs to. np_orgs membership is a name-match funnel stage, not a Native ruling: 12,393 of its 12,764 rows are UNRULED and 4,933 are confidence_tier X, which is a NEGATIVE ruling. np_orgs_EXCLUDED_by_prior_ruling rows are carried so the exclusion stays visible and must never be read as Native. Only np_orgs_ruled_* rests on an adjudication.
columns.name: filer_population

columns.description: 1 only where np_orgs carries a positive classification_ruling (native_controlled, tribally_controlled, native_serving). Everything else is 0, including tier A candidates.
columns.name: filer_is_ruled_native

columns.description: Year of TaxPeriodEndDt on the return. Not the submission year.
columns.name: tax_year

columns.description: 990, 990EZ or 990PF as reported in ReturnHeader/ReturnTypeCd.
columns.name: return_type

columns.description: IRS e-file return object id. The primary key of the return in the IRS index and archives.
columns.name: object_id

columns.description: Recipient organisation name exactly as the filer typed it on Schedule I Part II, both name lines joined. Never corrected.
examples: CONSERVATION CENTER FOR ART AND HISTORIC ARTIFACTS
US CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN PROVINCE SOCIETY OF JESUS
UNITED WAY OF THE GREATER CHIPPEWA VALLEY INC
columns.name: recipient_name_as_filed

columns.description: Recipient EIN as reported by the filer. Blank where the filer reported none.
columns.name: recipient_ein

columns.description: IRC section of the recipient as stated by the filer. A filer writing TRIBE here is naming an entity outside the Form 990 universe under IRC 7871.
columns.name: irc_section_as_filed

columns.description: CashGrantAmt for this recipient. Schedule I Part II has a $5,000 floor, so smaller grants are absent by construction.
columns.name: cash_grant_usd

columns.description: NonCashAssistanceAmt for this recipient. Never added to cash without saying so.
columns.name: noncash_assistance_usd

examples: VARIOUS EQUIPMENT AND SUPPLIES FOR USE IN COLLEGE PROGRAMS
Transfer of equipment and landhold improvements
EQUIPMENT, VEHICLES, BUILDING, VARIOUS NON-CASH DONATIONS.
columns.name: noncash_description

columns.description: PurposeOfGrantTxt. A purpose line is not a grant agreement and does not establish whether the grant was restricted.
examples: TO ASSIST THE ORGANIZATION IN FURTHERING ITS PURPOSE AND GOALS
DISTRIBUTION TO THE UNITED WAY OF THE GREATER CHIPPEWA VALLEY, INC TO OFFSET THE
columns.name: purpose_as_filed

columns.description: 1 where the recipient EIN is in the Cedar Native-connected nonprofit universe (np_orgs.csv, IRS EO BMF). An EIN join, no name matching.
columns.name: recipient_ein_in_np_orgs

examples: UNITED WAY OF THE GREATER CHIPPEWA VALLEY INC
UNITED CEREBRAL PALSY ASSOCIATION OF CAYUGA COUNTY INC
HUMAN SERVICES COALITION OF CAYUGA COUNTY INC
LITERACY VOLUNTEERS OF CAYUGA COUNTY INC
TRANSPORTATION PROJECT FOR CAYUGA COUNTY INC
THE YOUNG MENS CHRISTIAN ASSO OF THE CHIPPEWA VALLEY INC
FAMILY PROMISE OF THE CHIPPEWA VALLEY INC
columns.name: recipient_np_orgs_name

columns.description: 1 where that EIN reports lobbying above zero on its OWN filed return in np_financials or np_grantee_financials. It is a fact about the recipient, not about this grant.
columns.name: recipient_reports_lobbying_on_own_990

columns.description: Recipient EIN tested against the FULL IRS EO Business Master File (1.96M organisations, eo1-eo4). absent_from_full_irs_bmf is the IRC 7871 signature - an entity outside the Form 990 universe, most often a tribal government. Never tested against the 12,764-row Native-connected slice, which answers a different question.
columns.name: recipient_bmf_status

columns.description: Recipient name as the IRS BMF holds it, where the EIN is in the BMF. Independent of the name the filer typed, so the two can be compared.
examples: CONSERVATION CENTER FOR ART AND HISTORIC ARTIFACTS
FRIENDS OF THE STILLWATER PUBLIC LIBRARY
UNITED WAY OF THE GREATER CHIPPEWA VALLEY INC
AURORA OF CENTRAL NEW YORK INC
BOOKER T WASHINGTON COMMUNITY CENTER OF AUBURN NEW YORK INC
UNITED CEREBRAL PALSY ASSOCIATION OF CAYUGA COUNTY INC
GIRL SCOUTS OF NYPENN PATHWAYS INC
HUMAN SERVICES COALITION OF CAYUGA COUNTY INC
columns.name: recipient_bmf_name

columns.description: BMF filing requirement code for the recipient. 02 is a 990-N e-Postcard filer, which reports gross receipts and nothing else; zero lobbying there is the filing regime, not a finding.
columns.name: recipient_bmf_filing_req_cd

columns.description: 1 where the recipient is absent from the full BMF, or the filer itself wrote TRIBE / TRIBAL / GOVERNMENT / 7871 in the IRC section. Such an entity files no Form 990 and its absence is never a gap.
columns.name: recipient_outside_990_universe_signal
